routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (11/18 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.prompt: 신입 직원 적응 교육 — training for new staff 대신
잘 안 쓰이는, 활용이 적은 — not used much 대신
(다른 자료와) 대조해 확인하다 — check with 대신

items.answer: My understanding is that ~. Please correct me if I'm wrong.
Depending on ~, we will decide whether to ~.

items.prompt: 수령, 받음: Please confirm ____ of the passport copy.
전담의 — only for this job 대신: a ____ team

cover_practice.prompt: 무단의: Using the company car for personal trips is u___________ use.
명시하다: The contract must s______ who pays for lift on/off.
상한을 두다: HQ wants to c__ the monthly taxi cost at 2 million VND.
넘기다: Unused leave days cannot be c______ o___ to next year.
이번 달 전기 요금이 평소보다 훨씬 높으니 안 쓰는 에어컨은 꺼 주세요. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: This month's electricity bill is well above our usual level, so please turn off unused air conditioners.

cover_practice.prompt: 온라인 양식이 고쳐질 때까지 우선 종이 양식을 써 주세요. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Until the online form is updated, please use the paper form for now.

words.meaning: 승인받지 않은, 무단의 — not approved 대신
words.example: The price change on the invoice was unauthorized, so please revise it.
Please ask the supplier to specify the cushion strip in the quotation.
words.collocations: specify the price / as specified in the contract

words.meaning: 상한을 두다, 상한 — keep it under 대신
words.example: Please cap this week's consumables order at our weekly budget.
words.collocations: cap A at B / a budget cap

words.meaning: (다음 기간·목록으로) 넘기다 — move to next week 대신
words.example: Please carry over the three items to next week's list.
words.collocations: carry over to next month / carried-over items

patterns.pattern: Please do not ~ without my prior approval.
patterns.meaning: 제 사전 승인 없이 ~하지 마세요 (Do not change what I have not approved 대신, 선을 분명히 그을 때)
patterns.skeleton: Please do not + [동사] + without my prior approval
patterns.email: Please do not change an approved price without my prior approval.
patterns.spoken: Check with me first before you change it.

patterns.pattern: Until ~ is updated, please ~ for now.
patterns.meaning: ~가 고쳐질 때까지 우선 ~해 주세요 (임시 처리 방법을 알려 줄 때)
patterns.skeleton: Until + [주어] + is updated, please + [동사] + for now
patterns.email: Until the form is updated, please write the price in Special note for now.
patterns.spoken: For now, just put it in the note.

patterns.pattern: ~ is well above our usual level, so please ~.
patterns.meaning: ~가 평소보다 훨씬 높으니 ~해 주세요 (too high / much more than before 대신)
patterns.skeleton: [주어] + is well above our usual level, so please + [동사]
patterns.email: This week's total is well above our usual level, so please buy only what we need.
patterns.spoken: That's way more than usual. Just buy what we need.

source: 11/23 보낸 메일(생산소모품 주간 한도·다음 주 이월, 승인 안 된 단가 변경 지적, 절단기 점검 견적 항목 명시 요청, 인력 요청 온라인 양식 임시 처리)에서 고름. 11/24 보낸 메일 없음, 받은 메일은 따로 읽지 않음.
